axiom_audit.result: every listed theorem depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
axiom_audit.interpretation: The standard Lean 4 axiom set. No new axiom, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide anywhere in the route.

what_is_proved.headline: AllCoordinatesRawLocalContrastRankOne(F) implies F is multiaffine in its own normalised action coefficients: F x = sum_S c_S * prod_{i in S} theta_i(x_i).

chain.name: rawLocalContrastRankOne_iff_minors_zero
chain.content: raw rank one <-> every 2x2 minor of the (action x context) raw contrast matrix vanishes. Witness-free: no anchor witness, no reference measure, no factorisation.

chain.name: rawLocalContrastRankOne_iff_aligned
chain.content: raw rank one <-> centred rank one AND the first-order response contrast is kappa * lambda, i.e. no independent additive gauge. This is the exact gap between the raw and centred invariants.

chain.name: not_rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_misaligned
chain.content: nonzero alpha/lambda determinant, together with a context-separating h, refutes raw rank one. The non-degeneracy hypothesis is explicit in the statement.

chain.name: binary_allCoordinatesRawLocalContrastRankOne
chain.content: a two-letter alphabet forces raw rank one at every coordinate, for every F, unconditionally.

chain.name: rawLocalContrastRankOne_interpolation
chain.content: (star) F(z[i<-u]) = (1-theta_i(u)) F(z[i<-u0]) + theta_i(u) F(z[i<-r_i]). Derived from the minor identity in three lines; eliminates the existential factorisation from every later statement.

chain.name: rawRankOne_corner_reconstruction
chain.content: F is the tensor-product interpolation of its 2^m corner values.

chain.name: rawRankOne_normal_form_const_plus_interaction
chain.content: F = const + P(theta) with P carrying no constant term.

classical_not_novel: The corner reconstruction formula is the classical multilinear extension (Owen 1972 in cooperative game theory; standard multilinear interpolation on the hypercube).
The monomial/Moebius form with coefficients beta_S = sum_{T subset S} (-1)^(|S|-|T|) F(c_T) is the Moebius transform on the Boolean lattice (Rota 1964; Harsanyi dividends, Harsanyi 1963).
That a function affine in each variable separately is determined by its corner values is folklore.
ATTRIBUTIONS RECALLED, NOT VERIFIED AGAINST THE LITERATURE. Check before citing.
where_the_novelty_is: RawLocalContrastRankOne as an invariant, and the characterisation raw <-> centred AND alpha = kappa*lambda. This is the new object.

The linearity of the raw fibre: for fixed theta, raw rank one is a LINEAR condition on F, so the raw variety is a union of linear subspaces of dimension 2^m, at codimension m(K-2) inside the centred fibre. This is what makes unconstrained exhaustive search possible.
binary implies raw rank one, unconditionally: an explanation of the alphabet phase with no analytic input.
Using the (classical) normal form as an EXHAUSTIVENESS CERTIFICATE for a falsification search. The theorem is old; the role it plays is not.

explicit_non_claims: The all-coordinates-ACTIVE hypothesis has NOT been removed. Worlds with an inactive coordinate are not covered by the normal form. Removing it needs a canonical representative plus the convention theta_i = 0 on inactive coordinates.
The link theta <-> phi is NOT proved, so 'raw variety = union over phi of V^raw_phi' is NOT yet a theorem.
D6-prime (the decision bound under raw rank one) is COMPLETELY OPEN. Nothing here bears on whether it is true.
None of this re-proves or weakens the D6 falsification, which remains an exact rational counterexample.
